name: Git Tools
description: Do Git work directly inside Alpha File Manager: init, clone, fetch, pull, push, sync, browse branches, commits and tracked files, and hand the repository to your IDE.

commands.title: Git - Repository status
commands.description: Show branch, upstream and changed entries of the current repository

commands.title: Git - Initialize repository
commands.description: Run git init in the current directory

commands.title: Git - Clone repository
commands.description: Clone a remote repository into a target directory

commands.title: Git - Fetch remotes
commands.description: Fetch all remotes of the current repository

commands.title: Git - Pull
commands.description: Pull the current branch from its upstream

commands.title: Git - Push
commands.description: Push the current branch to its upstream

commands.title: Git - Sync (fetch + pull)
commands.description: Fetch all remotes and then pull the current branch

commands.title: Git - Commit history
commands.description: Show the last 50 commits of the current branch

commands.title: Git - Browse repository files
commands.description: List the tracked entries of HEAD

commands.title: Git - Open in IDE
commands.description: Hand the repository directory to the configured editor command

commands.title: Git - Set IDE command
commands.description: Choose the editor command used by Open in IDE
